description: Plan solar modules on a house's roof from the Bavarian 3D building model, the aerial photo and the laser scan, exactly as Sky Solar's solar roof check page does: modules, kWp, kWh a year with measured weather, shade loss and self-use with and without a battery, each roof face with tilt and direction, the obstacles found, money a year at public rates (own use and feed-in) for a choice of battery sizes (none, or 4 to 20 kWh; any whole kWh in between on request), the municipal subsidy and, with an offer price, the payback, kWh month by month and per face, the worst shade casters, questions about unsure spots for the person and what else to ask them, notes on likely model errors, and a solar roof check link that opens this plan in 3D for the person to check, change and send an enquiry from. Give house (from find_house) for a new plan, or link to read and explain a plan the person already has. Pass the person's answers to the questions with answers. Works outside Sky Solar's service area too and says so. An example, not a quote; no prices.

answers.description: The person's answers to the last answer's "questions".

id.description: The id of a question from the last answer.

obstacle.description: true: there is an obstacle there; false: there is none.

battery_kwh.description: Battery size, kWh: 0 for none, or a whole number from 4 to 20 (default 8).

consumption_kwh.description: The household's electricity use a year, kWh, without car or heat pump (default 4,500).

ev.description: An electric car is (or will be) charged at home: about 2,700 kWh a year more.

heat_pump.description: A heat pump heats the house: about 4,500 kWh a year more.

house.description: The house id from find_house ("musterhaus" is the example house).

link.description: A solar roof check link (https://pv.skysolar.de/dachcheck/#d=…), as plan_roof, edit_roof or the solar roof check page gave it.

offer_eur.description: The total price on an offer the person already has, euros before any subsidy (0 clears it): the solar roof check link then shows the payback. Never a price of Sky Solar's.

name: plan_roof
title: Plan a roof (solar roof check)
